t: You're at the war memorial at the Church of St Mary in Stoke Newington. It was designed by Charles Marriott Oldrid Scott, who lived from 1880 to 1952. He came from a famous architectural family. His father was John Oldrid Scott and his grandfather was Sir Gilbert Scott. His uncle and his cousins, including Sir Giles Gilbert Scott and Adrian Gilbert Scott, were architects too. Later in life he moved to Little Kimble, near Aylesbury.
